about: What splice.torad.ai's page must keep within reach, word for word: every command, file path, question, link and control the page offered before its redo (Oct 31, 2026), read from the live page. The redo may redraw anything and may say a claim in fewer words, but it never drops one of these. tools/release/test/website.test.ts reads this list against the built page. Claims in prose are judged by a reader, not by this list, since the redo turns them into labels.

head_about: What the live page's head told browsers, search engines and link previews. An entry `key = content` is a meta tag (by name or property, its media after the key) or a link (by rel, its href) the page keeps word for word; an entry with no ` = ` is one it keeps with a value of its own (the browser bar's colour follows the page's own ground). The charset, the viewport and the font preloads are how a page renders, not what it tells anyone, so they are left out. schema lists the types in the page's JSON-LD graph.
